overview: The Council requested reports on early retirement incentives, library construction finances, and emergency response plans for essential personnel. They also approved a sidewalk loan order, selected a zoning consultant for recodification, and discussed safety protocols for returning to in-person meetings.

items.title: Early Retirement Incentive Program
items.summary: Requested that the administration and retirement board examine the feasibility and cost savings of offering an early retirement incentive program.

items.title: Medford Public Library Construction Costs
items.summary: Requested a financial report on construction costs, state grant status, and private fundraising for the library, including a request for a future project update meeting.

items.title: Substance Abuse Trends
items.summary: Requested an analysis from the Director of Substance Abuse Prevention regarding addiction trends during the government shutdown.

items.title: Essential Personnel Emergency Response
items.summary: Requested the city's emergency response plan for protecting essential personnel and updates on the procurement of personal protective equipment.

items.title: Council Chamber Safety and COVID-19 Testing
items.summary: Approved requesting plexiglass panels in the chambers and COVID-19 testing for members, alongside a request for state guidance on resuming in-person public meetings.

items.title: Democratic Committee Leadership
items.summary: Congratulated the outgoing and incoming co-chairs of the Medford Democratic Ward and City Committee.

items.title: Traffic and Pedestrian Safety Improvements
items.summary: Requested crossing signals at Central Avenue and Spring Street, plus traffic calming measures and crosswalk updates for Locust Street, Tufts Square, and Salem Street.

items.title: Sidewalk Loan Order Third Reading
items.summary: Approved a loan order for city sidewalks on its third and final reading.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognition and Condolences
items.summary: Honored a resident on her 80th birthday and passed condolences for Marie DeBenedetto and Amelia Prestigiovanni.

items.title: Fiscal Year Budget and Consultant Updates
items.summary: Approved the fiscal year budget update and voted to invite the School Committee to join future financial planning meetings with the city's consultant.

items.title: Zoning Recodification and Marijuana Ordinance
items.summary: Selected UTILE for zoning recodification and approved a committee report on the proposed marijuana ordinance following legal review.
